name: PDF.co
label: PDF.co Web API v1
description: PDF.co Web API v1. Official API https://docs.pdf.co/api-reference. One node; pick operation. Operations send url/html JSON bodies. OUTPUT file is a platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type. Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Files are uploaded to PDF.co — DPA if PHI. Do not store PDF.co outputDataFormat=base64 as the StudioQuack type.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_convert, pdf_add_text, pdf_extract_text, pdf_barcode, html_to_pdf, url_to_pdf.

schema.label: name
schema.description: File, folder, bucket, or display name.

schema.label: url
schema.description: Request-body parameter `url` for operations: pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_convert, pdf_add_text, pdf_extract_text, url_to_pdf.

schema.label: Target Format
schema.description: Convert target format for pdf_convert path /pdf/convert/to/{target_format}. EXACT: csv|json|text|jpg|png|…. Example: csv.

schema.label: Urls
schema.description: Comma-separated source file URLs for pdf_merge. Example: https://a.pdf,https://b.pdf.

schema.label: pages
schema.description: Request-body parameter `pages` for operations: pdf_split, pdf_convert.

schema.label: annotations
schema.description: Request-body parameter `annotations` for operation: pdf_add_text.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Request-body parameter `value` for operation: pdf_barcode.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Request-body parameter `type` for operation: pdf_barcode.

schema.label: Barcode Type
schema.description: Barcode type for pdf_barcode (read/generate). Example: Code128.

schema.label: html
schema.description: Request-body parameter `html` for operation: html_to_pdf.

schema.label: async
schema.description: All convert ops. true returns a job id. Example: false.

schema.label: callback
schema.description: Webhook URL for async completion. Example: https://example.com/hook.

schema.label: password
schema.description: Source PDF password when the file is encrypted. Never log.

schema.label: httpusername
schema.description: HTTP Basic user when url requires auth.

schema.label: httppassword
schema.description: HTTP Basic password when url requires auth. Never log.

schema.label: expiration
schema.description: Result file TTL in minutes (PDF.co). Example: 60.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on success.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body or text.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: PDF.co dashboard API key (x-api-key). StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Urls
configurationParameters.description: Comma-separated source file URLs for pdf_merge.

configurationParameters.label: Target Format
configurationParameters.description: Convert target format for pdf_convert. Example: csv.

configurationParameters.label: Barcode Type
configurationParameters.description: Barcode type for pdf_barcode. Example: Code128.
